_comment: Known column-level drift that scripts/drift-check.ts (#2508) is told to tolerate, so the screen can run unattended in CI and nightly without going red for a fact already scheduled away. Follows the convention of scripts/schema-drift-baseline.json (#1883) and KNOWN_REDUNDANT_DUPLICATE_INDEXES (#2264): an entry is a debt record, not a mute button. Rules: (1) key is `kind:table.column` where kind is nullability | type | presence, exactly as the script emits it; (2) every entry names the migration that clears it (`clearedBy`) or the issue that owns the fix (`filedAs`) — an entry with neither is a bug report suppressed, not drift recorded; (3) entries are checked against both databases the screen runs against, and the chain-built one (npm run db:bootstrap) is where a `filedAs` entry must disappear first, because that build is the migration chain; (4) when an entry stops firing the script prints a `[allowlist]` ratchet line naming it — delete the entry in that PR. Never add an entry for drift you have not measured on a real database.

entries.reason: Live is NOT NULL with no default; drizzle/schema/support.ts:132 declares it nullable because #2444 retired the credential and no insert supplies a value any more. `0124` is the DDL, pending on pre-prod. See #2510 for both dispositions and the 0057 CHECK constraints that assume text.
